name: Balancer v2 Composable Stable Pool rounding exploit (mainnet leg)
one_liner: Balancer v2 mainnet: whitehat Bitfinding replayed the attacker's exploit input one block after it landed, rescued about 260 ETH-equivalent in this tx, and returned it to the DAO; a 10% bounty was paid on 2026-01-15.
bot: Bitfinding (whitehat; identity matched to BIP-892 by exact amounts)
narrative: On the Ethereum mainnet leg no bot or whitehat front-ran an attacker tx. Every replay of the attacker calls (Bitfinding 0x5af00b07 = the whitehat that returned ~$964K; plus searcher/copycat EOAs) lands in a LATER block than the attacker tx on the same pool: Bitfinding 1 block after A1 (23717398 vs 23717397), 4 blocks after A3, 3 blocks after A9. The call data is a confirmed adaptation (A1 creation input vs Bitfinding input: 3 of 983 32-byte words differ, all address constants), so the "front-ran the attacker" wording in the Balancer post-mortem (as quoted by AMBCrypto) is a post-inclusion replay/rescue of the residual pool balances, not a pre-emption of a pending attacker tx. A1 and most attacker txs never appeared in the public mempool; the only public pending ones (A8-A9b) were not pre-empted. Same-block activity before/after the attacker is arbitrage backrunning (0xc0ffee445a22 at idx 2 paying 20.6 ETH to the builder).
chain: ethereum (mainnet leg only; Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon, Gnosis also hit)

fate.text: Bitfinding returned its mainnet recoveries to the DAO multisig: wstETH 10.956795 (block 23722968, 2025-11-04), WETH 136.000912 (block 23722994, 2025-11-04; includes 0.144 WETH from its third replay), osETH 105.208208 (block 23756834, 2025-11-08), plus rETH and weETH from its second replay. Balancer's post-mortem put the total at about $964K ($963,832 in BIP-892). The DAO paid the 10% whitehat bounty to 0xc3C7ccE1962B7a744847933CC3abD50b67ff5402 on 2026-01-15 (tx 0xaa0de3c2, block 24237348). Row-level ETH-equivalents (this tx's three assets only): returned in full = 260.5277; net of the 10% bounty = 234.4749.

sources: https://ambcrypto.com/balancer-recovers-45-7m-after-121m-hack-but-bal-stays-down-24/ (quotes Balancer post-mortem: "Bitfinding alone front-ran attackers on Ethereum Mainnet for $964,000")

dataset_money.note: Scope: the Bitfinding replay of A1 (tx 0x1dc60f91 at idx 2 plus its two follow-up txs at idx 3-4, same EOA and block); coinbase and priority fee are summed over those three txs. Bitfinding paid 2 gwei priority (0.058352 ETH), no coinbase transfer, and received no builder refund (no transfer from the fee recipient to the bot in the block). bot_net is the gross rescued value held before it was returned to the DAO multisig; it is a whitehat rescue, not profit. ETH-equivalents use on-chain exchange rates at block 23717398 (see method) so they are approximate. The attacker's own take (6,587 WETH / 6,851 osETH / 4,260 wstETH in A2) is a different scope.
